# Hoan Huynh

## A

futureYou.personTheyWillBecome: You will become a highly sought-after Full-Stack Engineer commanding 2500-3200 USD/month, recognized in Vietnam's tech community for building scalable, production-grade systems that balance performance obsession with architectural elegance. Your portfolio of open-source design system contributions and published technical case studies will make you visible to top-tier companies (MoMo, Mindera, Magnolia), while your mastery of system design, testing discipline, and cloud infrastructure will position you for seamless progression into senior/staff roles within 3-5 years.
futureYou.achievementSummary: Launched two published open-source projects (a React design system and a Node.js performance toolkit); authored 8+ technical blog posts with 5K+ combined views; contributed to 3+ high-impact open-source projects; completed AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification; built and shipped 2 end-to-end full-stack features with 95%+ test coverage and architectural documentation; mentored 3+ engineers through code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions; and secured a Senior Full-Stack or Staff Frontend role at a tier-1 Vietnamese tech company with 20-30% salary increase.

phases.goal: Build visible proof of testing discipline, cloud infrastructure basics, and early open-source credibility while securing a mid-level role at a tier-1 company
actions: Create a public GitHub portfolio project: Build a React + Node.js/Fastify expense tracker with PostgreSQL that demonstrates unit tests (Jest), integration tests, and E2E tests (Playwright/Cypress). Achieve 80%+ code coverage and document testing strategy in README.

Complete AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification (choose one). Document your learning journey in a 3-part blog series on DEV.to or Medium covering VPC setup, API Gateway, Lambda, and database scaling patterns.

Contribute to your first open-source project: Find 2-3 small issues in popular React or Node.js libraries (e.g., next.js, fastify, vercel/swr, react-hook-form). Submit pull requests with tests and meaningful commit messages. Target 2 merged contributions.

Audit your current fintech codebase for testing gaps: Implement unit tests for 3 critical React components and 2 Node.js API endpoints using Jest + React Testing Library. Quantify the improvement (e.g., 'Increased test coverage from 12% to 45% across payment dashboard module').

Apply to 4-5 mid-level full-stack or frontend roles at target companies (MoMo, Cake, ITC Group, AdvaHealth). Tailor cover letters to emphasize fintech performance optimization experience and new testing/cloud knowledge. Target 2 interviews minimum.

Establish a weekly learning habit: 2 hours on system design fundamentals (read 'Designing Data-Intensive Applications' or watch System Design Interview YouTube channel). Document 1 design question per week in a private notion/github wiki.
skills: Unit testing and test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library)
Integration and E2E testing frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Supertest)
AWS or Google Cloud fundamentals (compute, networking, databases, CI/CD)
Version control and open-source contribution workflows (Git, GitHub, PR review process)
phases.milestone: Secure a mid-level Full-Stack or Frontend Engineer offer at a tier-1 Vietnamese tech company (MoMo, Cake, ITC Group, Mindera, Magnolia) with 2000-2500 USD/month base salary; have 2+ merged open-source contributions and 1 published technical blog post with 200+ views; demonstrate 80%+ test coverage on a public GitHub portfolio project.

phases.goal: Establish yourself as a visible technical thought leader with deep full-stack and system design expertise, while owning end-to-end architectural decisions in your new role
actions: Own end-to-end architecture for 2 significant features at your new company: One frontend-heavy feature (e.g., real-time dashboard with WebSockets) and one full-stack feature (e.g., payment processing pipeline with async job queues). Document architectural decisions, trade-offs, and performance metrics in internal design documents and external blog posts (2 posts).

Lead the design and launch of an internal or open-source design system: Create a React component library with Storybook, TypeScript, Tailwind, and comprehensive documentation. Include 15+ reusable components (buttons, forms, modals, cards, etc.) with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA). Publish to npm or GitHub and write a 2000-word case study.

Publish 6 technical articles on DEV.to, Medium, or your own blog covering: (1) 'Lessons from 3 years of fintech frontend optimization', (2) 'System design patterns for real-time trading dashboards', (3) 'Testing strategy for full-stack Node.js + React applications', (4) 'Cost-effective AWS architecture for mid-stage startups', (5-6) 2 deep-dives on specific technologies or patterns you've mastered. Target 1K+ views per article; aim for 10K+ combined reach.

Contribute meaningfully to 3-5 open-source projects: Move beyond small bug fixes. Target projects aligned with your interests (design systems, dev tooling, performance libraries). Submit 1-2 features or significant refactors. Examples: contribute a new hook to a popular React library, add a performance optimization to Next.js, or enhance a testing library.

Mentor 2-3 junior engineers formally: Establish a weekly 1:1 mentoring cadence. Focus on system design thinking, testing discipline, and code review feedback. Document mentoring outcomes (e.g., 'Junior engineer shipped first full-stack feature with 90% test coverage').

Expand cloud infrastructure skills: Achieve proficiency in containerization (Docker), orchestration (Docker Compose or Kubernetes basics), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation). Deploy at least 2 projects using these tools and document the setup process.
skills: System design and architectural thinking (distributed systems, scalability, trade-offs)
Design systems and component-driven architecture (Storybook, design tokens, accessibility)
Advanced DevOps and infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes basics, IaC, CI/CD pipelines)
Performance optimization at scale (profiling, caching strategies, database optimization, monitoring)
Technical leadership and mentorship (code review, architectural guidance, knowledge transfer)
Public speaking and technical writing (blog posts, conference proposals, documentation)
phases.milestone: Publish 6+ technical articles with 10K+ combined views; launch and maintain an open-source design system with 100+ GitHub stars; own 2 end-to-end architectural projects with documented design decisions and 95%+ test coverage; mentor 2-3 junior engineers with measurable outcomes; secure a senior-level offer (2800-3500 USD/month) or receive promotion at current company based on technical visibility and system design expertise.

phases.goal: Transition into a senior or staff-level role with proven system design expertise, technical visibility, and organizational leadership impact; position yourself for future CTO/VP Engineering trajectories or founding team roles
actions: Take on a formal technical leadership role: Seek promotion to Senior Full-Stack or Staff Frontend Engineer; or join a startup as an early engineer with technical co-founder trajectory. Own architectural decisions across 2-3 critical systems (e.g., payment infrastructure, real-time notification system, scalable data pipeline). Lead RFC (Request for Comments) reviews and technical standards definition for your organization.

Build a signature open-source project or initiative: Create a widely-adopted tool, library, or framework that solves a real problem in the fintech/fullstack developer community. Examples: a performance monitoring toolkit for React+Node, an open-source design system component library, or a developer experience tool for modern fullstack apps. Target 500+ GitHub stars, 10K+ npm downloads/month, and 3+ production users by year 4.

Establish yourself as a recognized expert through speaking and writing: Give 2-3 talks at major conferences (JSConf, ReactConf, or regional tech conferences in Southeast Asia). Publish 12+ thought leadership articles on complex topics (system design for fintech, scaling React at enterprise, etc.). Build an audience of 5K+ followers on Twitter/LinkedIn around your technical expertise.

Mentor and grow engineering talent at organizational scale: Establish a structured mentorship program at your company. Mentor 3-5 mid-level engineers through code reviews, architecture discussions, and career planning. Track outcomes: engineers mentored into senior roles, code quality improvements, architectural decisions influenced.

Expand into adjacent leadership domains: Learn about product strategy, business metrics, and team dynamics. Participate in hiring and promotion decisions. Contribute to your company's technical strategy and roadmap. Build credibility for potential tech lead, principal engineer, or engineering manager roles.

Document your journey into a 'lessons learned' course or book: Synthesize your 6+ years of fintech and fullstack experience into a teaching artifact (online course, e-book, or video series). Cover: 'From Mid-Level to Staff Engineer: System Design, Leadership, and Visibility'. Target 1K+ students/readers and position yourself as an authority in your domain.
skills: Architecture and system design at enterprise scale (distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture)
Technical leadership and organizational influence (RFCs, standards, technical vision)
Product thinking and business acumen (metrics, OKRs, user impact, technical debt management)
Team building and engineering culture (hiring, mentorship, knowledge sharing, retention)
Public presence and thought leadership (speaking, writing, community building)
Strategic career positioning (personal brand, network leverage, emerging technology adoption)
phases.milestone: Achieve senior or staff-level role with 25-40% salary increase from phase 2 baseline (3500-5000+ USD/month); launch or maintain a signature open-source project with 500+ stars and 10K+ monthly adoption; deliver 2-3 conference talks or keynotes; publish 12+ thought leadership articles with 50K+ combined reach; mentor 3+ engineers into senior roles; influence 2-3 major architectural decisions that improved system reliability, performance, or scalability by measurable metrics (e.g., 50% latency reduction, 99.99% uptime achievement); position yourself as a recognized expert in fintech fullstack engineering within Vietnam's tech community.
